2020_169_oct_2020_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's October 2020 PCARD report itemizes district purchasing-card activity posted under the journal entry OCT PCARD EXPENSE, with each line showing the transaction date and merchant, the budget unit, the account code, and either a charge amount or a credit. The 23-page schedule, printed 12/10/2020 and presented at the December 15, 2020 Board meeting, covers transactions dated 9/28/2020 through 10/26/2020 across general fund, special education, community education, food service and student activity budget units. It reports a subtotal of 168,883.07 in transaction amounts against 3,078.18 in credits, and states Total Expenses of 165,804.89.

**Credits**
The largest credit is a 1,475.00 reversal to HUGGETT SOD on 10/16/2020 in budget unit 101904261870000. Others include AMZN MKTP US 279.99 (700970699990000, 10/22/2020), LINGTLANGUAG 168.00 (101071113325000, 10/23/2020), BED BATH & B 137.79 (101051112005100, 10/12/2020), two AMZN MKTP US credits of 95.37 each (101017111100100, 9/28/2020), OSU EHE T&L 75.00 (10/14/2020), AMZN MKTP US 75.99 (101008241031000, 10/9/2020), SP * FUTURE 57.00 (700071399708600, 10/14/2020), AMZN MKTP US 52.99, AMAZON.COM 51.90, FEDEX OFFIC4 49.64, 2.98 and 3.49, DEMCO INC 33.50 and 33.13, PAYPAL *OTO 29.00, and LOWES #01779 23.92.

**Spending patterns**
Amazon (AMZN MKTP US, AMAZON.COM, AMAZON PRIME) and Staples (STAPLS7315xx and STAPLES DIRE) dominate the line count. Other recurring merchants include Target, Meijer, Kroger, Dollar Tree, Lowe's, The Home Depot, Uline, Quill, Sam's Club, GFS, SSI School Specialty, Lakeshore Learning, Really Good Stuff, Demco and Follett. Software and subscription charges appear for SolarWinds, Zoom.us (530.00), Vimeo, Spotify USA (14.99), LogMeIn/GoToMeeting (912.00), Jotform (190.00), SignUpGenius, Adobe, Edpuzzle, Classkick, Seesaw, MobyMax (738.54), Study.com, Noteflight (379.00) and IFTTT Pro (1.99). Professional-association and conference charges go to MSBO, MACAE, ASCD, BCAM, MIVCA, Oakland Schools, MDE Educator and MSU Payments. A PCARD LATE F charge of 531.46 posts to 101668252024500, account 3190, on 10/26/2020.
